name: Stevenage January 2027
information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** **Dual Rounds** This competition will use Dual Rounds for 3x3 (see [regulation 9v](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9v)). Rounds 1 and 2 will take place as the first event of each day, so if you are only able to attend 1 day, you will still be able to compete in 3x3!
